name: User uses profanity after failed password reset
goal: Assess bot's ability to handle profanity and guide user through password reset.
constraints: Bot should remain professional, avoid repeating profanity, and focus on resolution.

phases.description: User attempts to reset password via SMS but encounters a failure.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot detects failure and offers troubleshooting steps.
Bot responds professionally, acknowledges frustration, and continues to assist.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
